_about: The real banana scan (farmer account, October 2026) whose result screen contradicted itself, read by BOTH test suites: msas-system/tests/Feature/ConsensusResultScreenTest.php (API subset, web history, PDF) and mobile/app/diagnosis/__tests__/consensusScreen.test.js (app). `inconclusive` is the record as the old wording vote stored it (three wordings of one finding, no majority); `normalAgeing` is the same three analyses under the condition-label vote. Both screens must agree with themselves: headline, health, severity and urgency from one source, at most 3 plain-language causes, 'What to do now', no Latin or jargon on the farmer's view.

steps.text: Look closely for soft, rotting or bad-smelling parts.
Cut off dead outer leaves or sheaths with a clean tool and take them away from the field.
Take a closer, sharper photo of the affected part in daylight and scan again.
If the problem spreads or you are not sure, contact an extension officer.

tips.text: Move closer so the affected part fills most of the photo.
Take the photo in daylight, without shadow on the affected part.
Hold the phone still and tap the screen on the affected part to focus.
If you can, include a healthy part next to the damaged one.
